label: D2 after a rewarded trial, common a2->S2 transition, mid-to-late episode (trials 50-79)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), only when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by the common transition, and only when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew 0 at D2; prev_reward 1 in 100% of activations). Never fires on S1, rare transitions, D1 or GO. A strong unexplained episode-time dependence: essentially all activations are at ep_trial 50-79 (peak 60-69), none before 40 or after 80, suggesting the unit integrates slow episode-time drift in the hidden state. Within that, it prefers steps where the policy readout strongly favors a2 (choice in [-8.9,-4.4]) and where S2 is the good state (84% of mass), i.e. long stable a2-rewarded streaks. Everything in the predicate is observed at D2 (state/common/action are known at D2). Precision remains limited (~0.56 dev): many matching steps are inactive, so the threshold depends on finer hidden-state factors not captured. Magnitude not systematically characterized beyond these trends.
